-- Net sales by region for Q3 FY2025/26 vs Q3 FY2024/25, with web as its own line
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    -- sales: stores on the sale date, web on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_region AS (
    -- as-is: region from the current store version (web shop 900 appears as 'Online')
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39)
       OR (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39)
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT fy26.region,
       fy26.net_sales AS fy2025_26_net_sales,
       fy25.net_sales AS fy2024_25_net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * (fy26.net_sales / fy25.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM by_region fy26
JOIN by_region fy25 ON fy25.region = fy26.region AND fy25.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE fy26.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY fy26.region;
